name: roofline
description: Log-log roofline for one GPU and dtype: attainable TFLOP/s vs arithmetic intensity (FLOP/byte). Draws the memory roof (HBM bandwidth x intensity), the compute roof (dense peak tensor rate) and the ridge point (peak / bandwidth, e.g. H100 bf16 = 295 FLOP/B). The operating point is a GEMM [M x K] . [K x N] with FLOPs = 2MNK and bytes = dtype_bytes x (MK + KN + MN), each matrix moved through HBM once; op time = max(FLOPs / peak, bytes / bandwidth). LLM framing: M = tokens in the batch (batch-1 decode is a GEMV with intensity about 1 FLOP/B in bf16), K = d_model, N = output dim of the projection. The learner can pick the GPU and dtype (fp32 uses the TF32 tensor rate; fp8 on GPUs without FP8 assumes FP8 storage with BF16 math; int8 uses INT8 TOPS), move M (1-16384, log), K and N (64-65536), use presets 'decode (batch 1)', 'decode (batch 64)', 'prefill (2048 tokens)', and overlay other GPUs' roofs to compare. GPUs: A100_SXM_80GB, H100_SXM, H200_SXM, B200, MI300X, RTX_4090, RX_7900_XTX. Good tasks: 'raise M until decode becomes compute-bound (find the batch at the ridge)', 'why does H200 speed up decode but not prefill vs H100?', 'how does fp8 move the ridge?', 'why is small-K/N work never compute-bound?'. Reported state: gpu, dtype, gemm_m_tokens, gemm_k, gemm_n, flops, bytes_moved, intensity_flop_per_byte, ridge_flop_per_byte, peak_tflops, hbm_bandwidth_tb_per_s, attainable_tflops, fraction_of_peak, op_time_us, bound (memory|compute), m_to_reach_ridge (null if unreachable at this K, N), compare (per compared GPU: ridge, attainable, op time), verdict.

dtype.description: Data type of both operands and the output; sets bytes per element and the peak rate.

m.description: M: rows of the activation matrix = tokens in the batch (1 = batch-1 decode).

n.description: N: output dimension of the weight matrix (e.g. d_model, 3*d_model for QKV, FFN width).

compare_gpus.description: Other GPUs whose roofs are overlaid (dashed) for comparison, with the same GEMM's point on each.
